modelObjects.name: Patrick Portfolio
modelObjects.description: Top-level landscape for Patrick MacLyman's project portfolio: a homelab Kubernetes platform, advisory agent governance, a unified search runtime, an LLM conversation archive, a cross-project agent learning corpus, a fleet conformance scanner, and a broad bench of personal tools and experiments.
modelObjects.caption: portfolio landscape

modelObjects.name: Operator (Patrick)
modelObjects.description: Human operator and decision owner across the portfolio. Directs agent work, maintains the homelab, and reviews learnings. Owns the North Star wording in every repo.
modelObjects.caption: human operator

modelObjects.name: AI Coding Agents
modelObjects.description: Cursor, Codex, and Claude Code agents that do the bulk of implementation work across repos. They produce transcripts, consume promoted skills, and are themselves governed by advisory PR agents.
modelObjects.caption: Cursor / Codex / Claude Code

modelObjects.name: Homelab Platform
modelObjects.description: coldaine-k8cluster-redoALL: a single declaratively-managed Kubernetes platform on Proxmox VE 9 + Talos VMs on VLAN 30. Git is the plan, not a controller; operators apply deliberately via Helmfile. Hosts apps, Postgres on CloudNativePG, in-cluster Garage S3, observability, and an EVO-X2 Qwen 3.6 inference sidecar.
modelObjects.caption: coldaine-k8cluster

modelObjects.name: Agent Governance
modelObjects.description: NorthStarGuardian and PRAgent: advisory GitHub review agents that evaluate PRs against a pinned North Star and produce dependency and architecture advisory comments. Never block merge by default.
modelObjects.caption: NorthStarGuardian + PRAgent

modelObjects.name: ColdSearch
modelObjects.description: Unified search/extract/crawl CLI over Tavily, Brave, Exa, Serper, Jina, Firecrawl, and SearXNG. Config-driven routing, fanout with RRF reranking, provider-tool profiles, and OpenAI-compatible agent mode. Local-first with a seam for future remote execution.
modelObjects.caption: coldsearch CLI

modelObjects.name: LLM Conversation Archive
modelObjects.description: llm-archiver v2 greenfield: capture every LLM conversation across the fleet into a queryable corpus with zero operational friction. v1 parsers frozen in git; v2 ingestion rework in progress. Will store on homelab Postgres via a custom all-extensions image (ADR 0009).
modelObjects.caption: llm-archiver

modelObjects.name: Agent Learning Corpus
modelObjects.description: agent-control-plane: cross-project store for distilled agent session learnings, retrospectives, and promotion candidates. Transcripts on disk are ground truth; this repo holds distilled lessons with links back to transcript IDs. Not a project authority repo.
modelObjects.caption: agent-control-plane

modelObjects.name: Portfolio Control Service
modelObjects.description: portfolio-control-service-demo: runnable fleet conformance scanner with layered org/tier/repo policy and a fixed R001-R014 rule catalog. Writes a JSON ledger and HTML report. A demo today, not a production policy engine.
modelObjects.caption: portfolio-control-service-demo

modelObjects.name: Personal Tools and Experiments
modelObjects.description: Breadth bench: ColdTools (tools consolidation monorepo with Chronograph, ColdOracle, ColdReviewer, PromptCannon, SemanticPlanner, NetworkConfig, and more), ColdVault (vault scope mapping), plus ComfyUI, HermesStart, HullZero, openscraper, TokenRouter, and WoWshipExport. Mixed personal tools, experiments, and one-off exporters.
modelObjects.caption: ColdTools + breadth repos

labels.repos: ColdTools, ColdVault, ComfyUI, HermesStart, HullZero, openscraper, TokenRouter, WoWshipExport

modelObjects.name: NorthStarGuardian
modelObjects.description: Advisory GitHub Action that reads the repo North Star, evaluates PRs against pinned principles, and posts a structured interview. Guardian-owned state lives under .github/guardian/ (snapshots, journal, sagas, drift ledger, dashboard). Pre-alpha but tested against synthetic PR fixtures.
modelObjects.caption: advisory PR alignment checker

modelObjects.name: PRAgent
modelObjects.description: Letta-centered advisory PR review skeleton: dependency triage plus exactly five architecture alternatives in one PR comment. Multiple focused agents invoked by a deterministic runner, no agent-to-agent orchestration. Advisory-only enforced by permissions, hooks, and validators. Not yet connected to a live Letta agent or GitHub App.
modelObjects.caption: advisory PR review agent

modelObjects.name: GitHub
modelObjects.description: Hosts all portfolio repos, the PR review flow, branch protection, and OpenSSF Scorecard. Governance agents read PR events here and post advisory comments. Agent identities should be GitHub App installation tokens, not human PATs.
modelObjects.caption: git hosting + PR flow

modelObjects.name: Doppler
modelObjects.description: Canonical secrets store. External Secrets Operator materializes runtime mirrors into the homelab; ColdSearch resolves provider keys via Doppler-injected env. No secret values in git; SOPS covers cluster recovery.
modelObjects.caption: secrets canonical

modelObjects.name: LLM and Agent Runtimes
modelObjects.description: OpenAI and Anthropic model APIs, plus the Letta agent/memory runtime. Guardian uses OpenAI/Anthropic for semantic review; PRAgent is Letta-centered; ColdSearch uses OpenAI-compatible endpoints (including the internal Qwen sidecar) and explicitly does not call Anthropic.
modelObjects.caption: OpenAI / Anthropic / Letta

modelObjects.name: Cloudflare
modelObjects.description: Edge and DNS for public homelab sites. Cloudflare R2 is the deferred offsite backup target; ADR 0012 keeps in-cluster Garage S3 as the current backup target.
modelObjects.caption: edge + R2 (deferred)

modelObjects.name: Linear
modelObjects.description: Optional managed North Star policy surface and follow-up issue routing for NorthStarGuardian. The exact policy snapshot used for every review is recorded regardless of source.
modelObjects.caption: policy + follow-ups

modelObjects.name: Search and Extract Providers
modelObjects.description: Tavily, Brave, Exa, Serper, Jina, Firecrawl, and operator-managed SearXNG. ColdSearch fans out across these with per-provider error isolation and RRF reranking. Several providers expose richer surfaces than ColdSearch currently implements.
modelObjects.caption: Tavily / Brave / Exa / ...
